subject: general
question:
Solve the following.

108 ÷ (36 × (1)/(4)) + (2)/(5) × 3(1)/(4) = ?
solution:
**Given: **

108 div(36 times{1over 4}) + { 2over 5} times 3{1over 4}

Concept:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a675f419aa3937529fff2adf5f3ef3604b17b86626f81ec9c24c60c85350d560.png] 

**Calculation:**

108 div(36 times{1over 4}) + { 2over 5} times 3{1over 4} \ = 108 div(9) + { 2over 5} times 3{1over 4}\ = 12 + { 2over 5} times {13over 4}\ = 12 + { 13over 10} \ = {133 over 10}\ = 13{3over10}
